antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 635nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in melanocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Single-wavelength 810nm: CcO activation at 370 THz, 10^-15s, continuous wave 40min targeting NO_synthase in melanocyte.
